statement: Every architecture-relevant item from the prior Final Audit catalogue, classified as PROTECTED_BY_EXISTING_INVARIANT, NEW_TEST_ADDED, or NOT_APPLICABLE_WITH_REASON. No new general audit was performed; this classifies the existing catalogue against the architecture as it stands after H1-H7.

classifications.subject: Historical verification passing on document shape alone
classifications.evidence: MODEL D forbids format-only termination; H1-03 asserts FORMAT_ONLY_VERIFICATION_REJECTED.

classifications.subject: Derived projection bytes unrecoverable once regenerated
classifications.evidence: H1-11/H1-12 reconstruct GATE_STATUS_SNAPSHOT@57 and ACTIVE_GATE@57 to their independently pinned digests.

classifications.subject: Generator identity treated as decoration
classifications.evidence: H1-13 shows substituting generator a4808b9e yields a non-matching digest; H1-14 blocks on identity mismatch.

classifications.subject: Mutable pointer pinned as if immutable
classifications.evidence: H1-07 rejects a permanently byte-pinned MUTABLE_PROJECTION; H4-09 rejects an ACTIVE_GATE pinning a derived projection.

classifications.subject: Immutable revision members silently mutated
classifications.evidence: STATE_SEAL member byte checks predate this program; CS-H01..CS-H03 still block. H4-04 confirms integrity mode still byte-checks them.

classifications.subject: Directory name deciding which revision is current
classifications.evidence: H2 removed readdir/max-revision authority; H2-10 pins the R9999 scenario that previously produced a false CHECKPOINT_ROLLBACK.

classifications.subject: Revision rollback
classifications.evidence: H2-11 blocks a later binding naming an earlier revision.

classifications.subject: Revision fork
classifications.evidence: H2-12 blocks two revisions claiming one predecessor.

classifications.subject: Orphan revision accepted
classifications.evidence: H2-10 reports ORPHAN_REVISION without altering the anchored resolution.

classifications.subject: R9999 weakening verification of an older seal
classifications.evidence: H3-07 proves an added revision directory changes neither verdict nor findings.

classifications.subject: Broken or unrooted seal chain
classifications.evidence: H2-13 blocks a chain that does not reach the root.

classifications.subject: Case-variant path resolving to a different file
classifications.evidence: H3-02 rejects a case-variant sealed member before its bytes are hashed.

classifications.subject: Sealed member reached through a symlink or junction
classifications.evidence: H3-03 rejects a member behind a directory junction.

classifications.subject: Sealed member set edited without detection
classifications.evidence: H3-04 breaks sealedMembersDigest when a member is appended.

classifications.subject: Relocated seal
classifications.evidence: H3-05 blocks a seal moved to another revision directory.

classifications.subject: Cross-Gate seal accepted inside the right subtree
classifications.evidence: H3-06 blocks; ACT-03 now rejects the same spoof strictly earlier as SEAL_INVALID.

classifications.subject: Historical replay reading present mutable projections
classifications.evidence: H4-02 pins the repaired replay --at 57; the split is MODE_LEDGER_INTEGRITY vs MODE_FULL.

classifications.subject: Lawful forward progress destroying replayable history
classifications.evidence: H4-03 advances a mutable pointer and shows history stays replayable while FULL mode still notices.

classifications.subject: Present consistency indistinguishable from ledger integrity
classifications.evidence: validatePresentConsistency() reports the two separately; H4-05.

classifications.subject: ACTIVE_GATE churning on every ledger append
classifications.evidence: H4-08 asserts currentStateSha256 is null and only stable activation identity is bound.

classifications.subject: Native-era event with no state binding
classifications.evidence: NATIVE_STATE_PIN_MISSING for ordinals >= 59; H2-03 and H7-07.

classifications.subject: Legacy migration record used as a permanent bypass
classifications.evidence: H5-H12 blocks NATIVE_ERA_MIGRATION_FORBIDDEN; no migration fallback exists at or after ordinal 59.

classifications.subject: Legacy binding inventing history it cannot support
classifications.evidence: H5-H01..H5-H13 each break exactly one piece of immutable agreement and block.

classifications.subject: Interpretation record smuggling a permission
classifications.evidence: H5-H14..H5-H17 refuse any FORBIDDEN_BINDING_CLAIMS field on sight.

classifications.subject: Duplicate or conflicting state bindings
classifications.evidence: H5-H18 covers both at document level.

classifications.subject: Candidate tree supplying the code that judges it
classifications.evidence: H6-05 runs the real tool with cwd inside a candidate shipping a sabotaged validator and a self-serving manifest.

classifications.subject: Replaying a historical verdict with today's validator
classifications.evidence: H6-06/H6-07 require retained historical validator identity for REPLAY.

classifications.subject: Contract succession invisible to the append-only spine
classifications.evidence: Event 59 records the succession; H7-07 binds it to the authority and the native state pin.

classifications.subject: Successor contract not declaring its predecessor
classifications.evidence: CONTRACT_SUCCESSION_LINEAGE_MISMATCH; H7-04 asserts previousContractPath/Sha on R0002.

classifications.subject: Stale impossible closure condition
classifications.evidence: H7-04 asserts 'GATE14 NOT_STARTED' is present in R0001 and removed in R0002.

classifications.subject: Whole growing-ledger digest as a contract input
classifications.evidence: H7-04 asserts the ledger input carries eventCount + prefixSha256 and no whole-file sha256.

classifications.subject: Digest cycle between an event and the seal it pins
classifications.evidence: H7-08 proves the R0003 seal embeds neither the event digest nor the event id and reproduces from its own inputs.

classifications.subject: A new transition class widening the closed execution table
classifications.evidence: H7-01/H7-02 keep the I2 table at 21, keep STATUSES unchanged, and constrain succession to one self-transition.

classifications.subject: Owner signature unavailability blocking lawful maintenance
classifications.evidence: LOCAL_EXPLICIT_AUTHORITY; LA01-LA07 and LAH01-LAH27. Signature material is rejected, not merely optional.

classifications.subject: Owner key rotation, revocation and recovery root lifecycle
classifications.reason: Removed from active scope by Project Owner decision. No new authority requires a signature, so there is no key lifecycle to manage. Historical signed artifacts remain verifiable against retained public key material only (LA06).

classifications.subject: External witness / independent anchoring infrastructure
classifications.reason: Explicitly out of scope: canonical history is anchored by committed Git history plus the append-only ledger. No standalone uncommitted NDJSON hash chain is introduced, so adding or removing a local record cannot redefine canonical authority.

classifications.subject: GEE R8 revision
classifications.reason: Forbidden by this program and asserted absent throughout (R8ExpectedAbsent, LAH08/LAH22, H7-10).

classifications.subject: GATE14 closure and external confirmation
classifications.reason: Forbidden by this program. GATE14 remains IN_PROGRESS with zero AGENT_CLOSURE and zero EXTERNAL_CONFIRMATION events (H7-10).

classifications.subject: ACTIVE_GATE succession GATE13 to GATE14
classifications.reason: Forbidden during GATE14. The generic succession primitive is implemented and tested (H4-10..H4-19) but deliberately not exercised against the repository; ACTIVE_GATE remains GATE13 (H4-20).
